finding.text: The task folder has no requirements.md (only past-work.md, session.jsonl, review/diff.patch), and session.jsonl has no outcome line, so "did it do what the owner asked" can only be judged from the title ("session switcher in the dictate widget, also the mobile sheet") and the code comments' "one-dictation item 4"; a fresh agent cannot continue from this folder alone. Add requirements.md with the owner's words and a landed outcome line.

The diff removes the desktop AI tab's v2 view chip: the old ai.js:183 `view.chip("drawer-ai-switch-btn")` is gone and `session_switcher()` does not draw one, so the Chat v1/v2 toggle disappears from the drawer's session strip (a regression, not asked for). Re-add it beside the switcher, or say it was dropped on purpose. `view` is now unused in `session_header` (ai.js:139) and the `.drawer-ai-switcher .drawer-rail-sheet-v2-chip` rule (drawer.css:185) is orphaned.

Docs are now stale: ux/Dictate/doc/chat.md:22, :94-98 and :243 still say the phone sheet's head, drawer AI tab and Dictate page "all call `new_session_button()`", and ext/drawer/doc/ai-tab-notes.md:66 still describes the list as built in the AI tab. `session_switcher()` and `chat.session_switcher` are not indexed anywhere in chat.md (law 9, law 10); document the export, its `keep: true` scope and the `stop()` method.

`session_switcher()` in chat.js subscribes with `chat.on_change(paint)` but nothing calls the returned `stop()`: ai.js:132 discards it, so each re-render of the session header (it repaints on every change) leaks one subscription and one extra `Session.recent_project` fetch per change until the element is disconnected. Call `stop()` from `session_header`'s `stop()` and have `paint` unsubscribe when `!$wrap.el.isConnected`.

`.drawer-ai-switch-list` styling (drawer.css:216-217) is unscoped but the button/row rules are keyed to `.drawer-rail-sheet`; the diff has no screenshot of the sheet at 400 px with the list open, so the "one rule styles both" claim in drawer.css:50-52 is untested here.

chat.js reads `get_mount()?.session?.()`, but chat.js has no `session()` method on mounts, so it always falls back to `chat.current()`. Harmless; the "mount is read only for .session()" doc comment overstates it.
The row title fallback changed from "Voice session" (old ai.js) to the raw `row.session` id, so an untitled session now shows a UUID in the list.

requirements.md is stale against the diff: ask 1 and 3 still say a `+ New session` button beside the list, and ask 2 gives `row.title ?? row.session` as the label. The built control is a "Switch session ▾" dropdown (ux/Popover `menu()`) beside a bare "+", the fallback is `"Session " + id`, and each row appends "(time ago)" (chat.js ~147-154). The "What was built" block also omits the pivot from an in-flow list to a Popover and the owner's 2026-10-25 "list breaks the UI" and dropdown-first/plus-last asks, so a fresh agent cannot tell what the owner finally approved.

Stale comments and docs still describe the old "+ New session button beside a list": ext/drawer/Sheet.js:330-333, ext/drawer/tabs/ai.js:178 (the `{ label: "+ New session" }` option was removed at :184, but the comment and the "until “+ New session”" title string at :173 remain), ext/drawer/readme.md:32 ("beside '+ New session'"), and the drawer.css:185 comment ("as tall as the New session button"). Update them to the dropdown plus "+" wording.

The task folder has no proof for the Popover change: review/ holds only diff.patch, with no shots and no report. The only evidence for "does not reflow the header" and "works in the phone sheet" is prose in the docs. Either add shots (drawer and sheet at 400 and 1200, menu open) or state in the task record that the check was done and where.

chat.js:~121 `paint()` calls `open_menu?.close()` on every `chat.on_change`, so a streaming reply or any chat event closes the dropdown while the owner is reading it. Closing only when the row set actually changed would be gentler.
The dead `.drawer-ai-switch-list` rule was replaced by a long "RETIRED" comment in drawer.css (~lines 200-206). The git history already says this, so the comment could be one line.

The bare "+" has `title` and `aria-label`, so it is accessible. It is also the only new-session control left on both surfaces, and it is easy to hit by mistake next to the dropdown. A confirm or an undo is not asked for, so this is only worth a look.
